title: The Function x/(x^2+1) Is Odd
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Decide whether f(x)=x/(x^2+1) is even, odd, or neither.

steps.title: Negate the Input
steps.explanation: The numerator flips sign while the squared denominator is unchanged.
steps.why: (-x)^2 = x^2, so only the top absorbs the minus.

steps.title: Compare with -f(x)
steps.explanation: Pulling the minus sign out front shows the result equals minus the original function.
steps.why: Factoring -1 from a fraction gives the negative of the fraction.

steps.title: Conclude
steps.explanation: The odd identity holds for all real x (the domain is symmetric), so f is odd and its graph has origin symmetry.
steps.why: The domain of f is all reals, so the oddness test applies at every point.
